hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) [ -f pyproject.toml ] && uv run -q ruff --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; uv run -q ruff check --fix -q -- "$f" >/dev/null; uv run -q ruff format -q -- "$f"; uv run -q ruff check -q -- "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; *) { [ -f biome.json ] || [ -f biome.jsonc ]; } && bunx biome --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; bunx biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true --colors=off -- "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac; exit 0
